title: Best Buy Bandits Caught in Massive Shoplifting Scheme: Cops
description:
A Florida couple was arrested after allegedly trying to pull off a large shoplifting scheme at Best Buy in Vero Beach on May 14. Indian River County police said Andrew Caua and Danielle Lorini were known among several retail stores in the area for accusations of stealing. The duo was hit with multiple charges, including grand theft and resisting arrest. A notebook allegedly penned by the pair showed various dates and stores, along with items on their “shopping list” with some saying “sold” next to them.
